notes: Modified cash basis audit. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-9; labels on pp6/8, totals on pp7/9). Disbursements printed by object only (no function); General/Street mixed lines put under general government with review. Debt Proceeds 3,115,000 (General Fund) is in Total Receipts; recorded as debt_proceeds. TIF Tax Collections classified property tax from the TIF Fund name. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement (p10): Total Operating Disbursements plus nonoperating interest, principal payment and Grants, Bonds & Loans (no single receipts total printed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p9), whose total 2,128,218.21 equals the government-wide governmental column (p1); business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Component unit (Development & Redevelopment Corporations) excluded. Detail: budget-and-actual receipts (p11) and disbursements (p12) schedules for General, Street and TIF funds (only total budgets printed, recorded in detail_totals), proprietary combining schedule (p13; budget column only combined, budget_final null; nonoperating lines are outside the operating totals). The Bond Fund has no schedule, so no detail lines for it; p14 is an unaudited fund summary (no line items). Read pages 1-14 of 14
